title: Administration
intro: Every action here is written to the audit log with the rule that was applied. Nothing on this page can be undone quietly.
signIn: Sign in with an account that has moderation rights to continue.
notAllowed: This account does not have moderation rights.

voices.title: Voices on the Wall
voices.intro: Taking a voice down removes it from the Wall and from the count. The person is not notified, and the record of your decision is permanent.
voices.confirm: Take this voice down? It leaves the Wall and the count immediately.
